llm.summary: This is a coherent Chinese murder-mystery writing skill, but its optional visualization template has browser-code risks that should be reviewed before use.

dimensions.detail: The optional generated HTML visualization loads remote D3 JavaScript and inserts generated DATA fields with innerHTML, creating avoidable browser execution risk if attacker-influenced story content is used.

llm.guidance: Use this skill mainly for Chinese-language murder-mystery writing. Avoid generating or sharing the optional HTML visualization from untrusted prompts until the template is fixed to render text safely, pin or bundle D3, and disclose network loading. Add content warnings for intense emotional, horror, death, family trauma, and betrayal themes.
llm.findings:
[T09] unexpected: Confirmed: references/visualization-template.html interpolates generated character, clue, timeline, and role fields into innerHTML. A visualization page is purpose-aligned, but unsafe rendering of user-influenced story data is not necessary and materially supports Review.
[T08] unexpected: Confirmed: the visualization template loads D3 from a third-party CDN using a mutable major-version URL and no integrity attribute. D3 use is aligned with the relationship graph feature, but the remote executable dependency is under-disclosed and unpinned.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Confirmed in context: browser visualization is disclosed as optional, but the external runtime dependency adds a network/code trust boundary beyond plain writing guidance.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: the referenced visualization template is present locally and was inspected; this is no longer a coverage blocker, though the template itself contains the browser-code issues noted above.
[SQP-1] expected: Partly accepted as a scope note: role design and clue design can be generic phrases, but they are central to murder-mystery writing and do not show hidden or privileged behavior.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: Chinese language, Chinese naming guidance, and 百变大侦探 submission standards are coherent with the skill's stated 剧本杀 focus, though users should treat them as locale-specific defaults.
[SQP-2] expected: Partly accepted as user guidance: emotional and horror themes are expected in this genre, but content warnings and audience calibration would make the skill safer for sensitive groups.
